subject: Sequencing & Algorithms
arc_note: K-frame (Problem Solving & Innovating) — NO C3 codes, NO text code, NO loops. The lane is ORDER: an algorithm is a list of steps in the right order. Two halves — (a) ordering routine/picture steps first/next/last (sheets 1-4, 8), and (b) giving/following step-by-step DIRECTIONS on a simple 1D path of numbered boxes using arrow symbols ➡ ⬅ (sheets 5-7). Distinct from Unplugged CT (classify/pattern lane) and Intro Block (coloured block-stack lane) — here arrows are unplugged path directions, NOT program blocks; positions stay 1D and ≤4 steps. Each answer (the order, the landing box, the needed arrows) is MODELLED + asserted in solution.py. Picture/symbol-driven via the `symbols` part; adult reads the short prompt, child draws/numbers/circles. Bit is the actor that follows the steps.
